root.label: East Pennsboro police arrest Chimaobim Igbojekwe

events.label: East Pennsboro police arrest Chimaobim Igbojekwe

slots.name: arrest count
slots.sentence: According to a police report obtained by The Associated Press, Chimaobim Adedayo Igbojekwe was arrested by an East Pennsboro Township police officer on Sept. 27 after a report of a suspicious vehicle parked next to a public park on a residential street in the Harrisburg suburb.

slots.name: criminal charges
slots.sentence: Igbojekwe was charged with disorderly conduct and indecent exposure.

events.label: Chimaobim Igbojekwe guilty plea to disorderly conduct
